text:
alex-support: Hey team, urgent customer ticket — after upgrading @redwood/inference TS SDK from 0.22.x -> 0.23.0 they get a 404 for the summarization route. Repro steps below, customer hit us with a production outage.

alex-support: Repro (minimal):
```json
// package.json deps
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@redwood/inference": "^0.23.0",
    "node": "18.x"
  }
}
```

alex-support: Code they run (TS):
```ts
import { InferenceClient } from '@redwood/inference';
const c = new InferenceClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY });
await c.summarize({ input: 'long article text...' }); // 404 here
```

alex-support: Curl against hosted API shows 404: `GET /v1/summarize` (they're using SDK, but SDK resolves to that route).

sam-devex: Thanks Alex — can you paste the full error payload the customer sees? Also which region/host are they on? Could be a rollout mismatch.

alex-support: Error body: `{ "error": "not_found", "message": "route not found: /v1/summarize" }`
Region: us-west-2 hosted. Customer says they did `npm ci` and redeploy.

kyle-eng: Quick note — there was a breaking rename in the SDK last week: the high-level `summarize` helper was moved to the `text.generate` namespace and the legacy alias was scheduled to be removed server-side for newer runtime API versions. We tried to keep a compatibility shim, but that only landed in SDK v0.24.x. 0.23.0 removed the old alias client-side but the hosted control plane still expects the old route for some tenants on older runtime versions, causing 404s. TL;DR: mismatch between SDK surface and control plane routing.

sam-devex: That matches past incidents. Two sensible customer-facing fixes: 1) ask customer to pin @redwood/inference to 0.22.x until we finish the rollout, or 2) upgrade to 0.24.1 which contains the shim + explicit route mapping.

alex-support: Can you confirm 0.24.1 is safe for production? Customer asked for an immediate patch.

kyle-eng: 0.24.1 includes: restored `summarize` alias, param rename handling (accepts both `input` and `content`), and a retry backoff for 404->fallback routing. It was QA'd yesterday and staged in canary. I can promote it to stable ASAP — but we also need to coordinate config on the control plane for the customer's environment (they're on an older runtime pool).

ci-bot: deploy-bot: Started canary rollout of @redwood/inference v0.24.1 to hosted-us-west-2 (10% traffic).

alex-support: Ok I told the customer: hold off on upgrading beyond 0.22.x, we're pushing a quick fix. I also gave them an immediate workaround using the REST path directly:
```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text.generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $KEY' -d '{"model":"x-small","input":"..."}'
```

sam-devex: Good. After rollout completes, follow up with the customer asking them to test 0.24.1. Also we should add a short KB explaining the temporary mismatch and pinning strategy.

kyle-eng: I'll open a PR to add a note in the changelog and a postmortem stub. Also scheduling a quick infra task to ensure the control plane mapping respects older runtime aliases during future SDK rollouts.

alex-support: Thanks all — I'll keep the ticket open until customer confirms. :thumbsup:
